metadata.description: The Claude Code Marketing Bootcamp marketplace. Four plugins: the core marketing-funnel toolkit (23 skills — landing pages, lead magnets, free tools, lead research, email nurture, dashboards, Voice Lab, campaign planning, install shield) plus three optional power-tools — Skyscraper (pre-build research), Funnel Hack (competitor teardown), and Browser Monkey (no-API analytics via browser automation).

plugins.name: claude-code-marketing-bootcamp
plugins.description: The complete Claude Code Marketing Bootcamp toolkit. 23 skills that build and deploy a full marketing funnel — landing pages, lead magnets, free tools, lead research, email nurture sequences, analytics dashboards — plus Voice Lab (10-skill voice training), campaign planning, and a supply-chain install shield. Say what you want; Claude runs the right skill. The core bootcamp install.

plugins.name: skyscraper
plugins.description: Scan existing solutions before you build from scratch. Fans out parallel scouts across native skills, Apify Store, Reddit, and YouTube, then returns a ranked report of what already exists and how to clone or adapt it. Run it whenever you're about to vibe-code a custom tool. Includes /skyscraper-setup for optional API-key status.

plugins.name: funnel-hack
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer a competitor's funnel and adapt it to your brand. Reads your working-dir brand config (mission, voice, ICP, offer ladder), then produces a steal / differentiate / content-ideas playbook snapped to YOUR positioning — not generic advice. Pairs with Skyscraper for full competitive intel.

plugins.name: browser-monkey
plugins.description: Two-phase browser API acceleration for no-API sources. The Sniffer discovers what APIs a site actually calls; Monkey replays them at fetch() speed with your own logged-in session — no Playwright UI, no API keys. Pull analytics from dashboards that have no public API (Substack and friends) into Supabase, then save the proven workflow as a reusable slash command. The Session 6 dashboard bonus. NOT for anti-bot platforms like LinkedIn.
